source.citation: Ermatchkov, Pérez-Salado Kamps, Speyer & Maurer 2006, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51, 1788
source.locators: Tables 1-3, p.1789; uncertainty statement, Results p.1789

transcription: All 52 rows of Tables 1-3, transcribed 2026-11-12 from the PDF text layer and checked against a rendered page image. alpha_per_PZ = mCO2/mPZ (stoichiometric molalities).
uncertainty: pCO2_total_uncertainty_kPa is the printed total (Delta p* + 0.02p), used once; pCO2_repeatability_kPa is the separate repeatability column.
role: Primary hold-out (owner decision 2026-11-11). Scored once per frozen endpoint; never used for fitting, start choice or selection. 393.15 K reported separately (above the 283-333 K carbamate-law range).
